evidence.note: Opens by explicitly framing foundations first — 'set up the foundational models, database schema' — rather than diving into spec-table endpoint order, showing foundation-before-features intent.

Isolates cross-cutting machinery into dedicated modules built BEFORE routes: db.py, errors.py, auth.py, idempotency.py, webhooks.py, billing.py. This dependency-aware separation of the error envelope, idempotency middleware, webhook engine, and background billing worker is an 8-level signal.

Uses TaskCreate as milestone markers: main app with health check first, then PaymentIntents/Charges/Refunds flagged as 'state machine is critical', then remaining endpoints. Sensible sequencing but the whole CRUD tail (products/prices/subs/invoices/events/webhook-endpoints/restricted-keys) is lumped into one undifferentiated milestone in step 18-19.

Milestones lack explicit done-conditions at creation; completion criteria emerge only during testing ('health endpoint operational, a key milestone'). Done-conditions are emergent rather than attached per milestone.

The riskiest subsystems (webhooks, restricted-key scoping) were built early as modules but not exercised/verified until very late, so hardest paths were not scheduled to de-risk early — falls short of the 10-level risk-front-loading.

reasoning: The agent went beyond a flat resource to-do list (>3): it explicitly sequenced foundations first and isolated cross-cutting machinery — error envelope, idempotency, webhook engine, billing worker — into their own dedicated modules/milestones ahead of routes, and flagged the PaymentIntent state machine as critical, which are hallmarks of the 8 anchor. But it falls short of 8 because milestones carry no concrete verifiable done-conditions at creation (completion criteria surface only during ad-hoc testing), the broad CRUD surface is collapsed into one lumped milestone, and the riskiest subsystems weren't scheduled to de-risk early. This places the observed behavior between the 'sensible milestone plan' (5) and the fully dependency-aware, done-condition-per-milestone (8) anchors, i.e. a 6.
